study: v31 local parameter evolution with rank-preserving randomized candidate positions
registration: Before v31 data preparation, generation or fitting. Completed v15 test outcomes and the v26 development sensitivity study motivate this exploratory intervention. Old test patients are not scored again. No API or remote training is used.
question: Does randomizing display positions during supervision reduce the learned display-prefix shortcut, and does own-error prioritization add benefit beyond ordinary updates and shuffled feedback under the same representation and budget?
source: Immutable prismatic-v15/cases.json: three patient-disjoint blocks of600 feedback admissions,100 proposal/loss-validation admissions and200 report-only guard admissions. Copy only those fields to the new prepared artifact; exclude the500 old test admissions. Keep fixed initial-8k candidate retrieval and recorded joint order templates. Verify source hash and patient separation before training.
representation: Every prompt retains the same patient context, all20 candidate drug/route/dose/unit fields, and each candidate's original retrieval rank. The output remains the exact20-position include/exclude mask. Ranked training presents original order. Other arms hash-permute candidates independently of labels using study/seed/round/view/case/original-index; remap masks by drug identity. No current target enters the prompt. Each sampled admission contributes one complete target sequence per round, with no clipping. Audit actual prompt/target token counts.
feedback: Each arm predicts the new600-case block with its latest raw adapter before using that block's GT. Ranked_uniform uses the ranked view; other arms use the same seed/round-specific permuted feedback view. Store immutable case/catalogue-bound outputs and exact sampling errors. Error is1-reachable-drug-set F1, with empty/empty equal1. Missing-catalogue GT remains in evaluation recall but does not distort selection-module feedback. Priorities for earlier blocks retain their original pre-update errors; this study does not claim fresh rescoring of every old case.
sampling: Uniform arms sample400 accumulated admissions without replacement. Own-error uses weights1+3*recorded_error. Shuffled-error permutes that arm's recorded error values across the accumulated case order using seed+10000*round, then uses the same weight formula. This preserves the marginal weight distribution but breaks case/error alignment. Same seed+round weighted sampling algorithm and same400-example/100-step budget for every arm. Training views are independently permuted from feedback views.
learning: Start every arm/seed from the same frozen backbone and fresh adapter. Continue each arm's latest raw adapter across three rounds, resetting optimizer state each round. Trainer seed equals the registered seed. Different seeds also use the three fixed block orders, so variation combines initialization, sampling and experience order. Save all original adapter bytes, optimizer-step logs, sampled membership, prepared supervision and feedback receipts.
proposal_selection: Use the same100 proposal admissions under ranked and a fixed label-independent permuted evaluation view. Select a checkpoint by the average of drug/core-order microF1 across these two views, keeping the earliest on ties within1e-12. Proposal cases also supply trainer validation loss; they never enter gradient updates. Base is eligible. Continue training from the latest raw adapter even if rejected. All four arms and three raw rounds freeze per seed before any guard generation for that seed.
guard_evaluation: After all choices freeze, evaluate base and every raw checkpoint on all200 guard admissions under ranked, fixed permuted and reversed rank-preserving views. Reconstruct accepted-state curves from frozen proposal choices without reselection. Guard is report-only. Do not reopen old tests; a new frozen confirmation/test protocol is separate future work.
controls: Direct original-retrieval-rank top8 and all20 candidate tools on exactly the same cases. Their medication/order sets are invariant to display order. Compare permuted_uniform with ranked_uniform for the representation intervention; compare own-error with permuted_uniform and shuffled-error for feedback-specific learning. All label-space and catalogue limits remain explicit.
endpoints: Drug/core-order microF1, patient-average F1, empty/invalid rates, nontrivial display-prefix and original-rank-prefix fractions, medication-set agreement/Jaccard between views, raw and proposal-accepted round curves, fixes/regressions, actual adapter changes, complete feedback lineage, target-token/step/inference budgets, three-seed variation and descriptive patient-cluster intervals conditional on those seeds.
audit: Independently rederive candidate permutations and mask targets from the immutable source, verify data/patient/GT equality, recount parsed outputs and scores, reconstruct every sampled weight/membership and frozen selection, verify actual100-step logs and original adapter hashes. Deduplicate identical prompts and preserve case-bound feedback receipts. An execution or accounting probe is not clinical improvement evidence.
scope: This is the legacy retrospective admission-proxy selection task; complete entry-time availability was not established. The local language model selects supplied recorded templates and does not invent doses. Parameters evolve; candidate tools, template memory and the update algorithm stay fixed. Improvements over base alone do not establish distinct RSI benefit or human-like prescribing. All patient records, predictions, adapters and model generation stay local. No saline-presence F1 and no clinical deployment.
